crossRefs.note: Then he said to me, “This is the curse that goes out over the surface of the whole land; for everyone who steals shall…
I will cause it to go out,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and it will enter into the house of the thief, and into the house…
I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers…

translations.web: He shall make the woman drink the water of bitterness that causes the curse; and the water that causes the curse shall enter into her and become bitter.
translations.bsb: He is to have the woman drink the bitter water that brings a curse, and it will enter her and may cause her bitter suffering.
translations.kjv: And he shall cause the woman to drink the bitter water that causeth the curse: and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter.
translations.asv: and he shall make the woman drink the water of bitterness that causeth the curse; and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her and become bitter.
